name: Aeronautics Department
tagline: Everything that flies within the atmosphere.
description: The Aeronautics Department designs, builds and flies. From fixed-wing RC aircraft to multirotor drones and flight simulation rigs, the team turns aerodynamics, structures and avionics theory into hardware that actually leaves the ground. Members learn CAD, composite building techniques, propulsion sizing and flight testing through hands-on projects and workshops.

name: Aerospace Department
tagline: From the edge of the atmosphere to orbit.
description: The Aerospace Department looks beyond the sky. The team works on model rocketry, CubeSat concepts, orbital mechanics and space engineering, and runs the club's astronomy program with our own telescope. It is the home of Space Day, our flagship event dedicated to AI, Earth observation and space engineering.
